# A new mob starts from templates that carry the team's core rulings
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #318, sha256:eb54fcefc4b838d3e4ff2f57de97061c0fc0673faf9d063b765aa60a50aad681). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->

<!-- phrase-card:318 -->

- **Status:** Draft
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (mob-defaults templates and guidance; written timeless)
- **Repository:** mob-defaults (mob-crosscli: the working-agreement template, the Ready check, the card template, the story and persona guidance)
- **Source:** the product owner's rulings of 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07: strict Decider voting (a No is a No), process changes as story issues, consumer value or waste (mob roles are never actors), every issue a Connextra story with Gherkin scenarios and explicit ZOMBIES coverage, and Riley valid only for dogfooding. The rulings are in this repository's TEAM_WORKING_AGREEMENT.md; mob-defaults has none of them yet.
- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Steve, the product owner starting a new mob, I want the mob-defaults templates and guidance to carry the team's core rulings, so that every new mob only works on things that deliver value to a consumer.
- **One user-observable outcome:** the product owner creates a new mob from mob-defaults and its working agreement, Ready check, card template and persona guidance already enforce the rulings, with no dates and no personal names in the template text.
- **Acceptance criteria (Gherkin; ZOMBIES letter in each title):**
  1. Scenario: [Z] [E] a card with no consumer value is refused. Given a new mob's card with no named consumer actor or value, When its Ready check runs, Then it is refused and names the missing actor or value; a mob role as actor is refused the same way.
  2. Scenario: [O] a card in the full format passes. Given one card with a Connextra story, Gherkin scenarios and all seven ZOMBIES letters tagged, When the Ready check runs, Then it passes.
  3. Scenario: [M] [B] coverage is verified letter by letter. Given a card whose scenarios cover six of the seven letters with no one-line reason for the seventh, When the Ready check runs, Then it fails and names the letter; a reason line the reviewer accepts lets it pass.
  4. Scenario: [I] the templates carry the rulings. Given the mob-defaults working-agreement template, card template and persona guidance, When a new mob is created, Then they state: a No is a No in a Decider vote, a process change is filed as a story issue, no value means no work, and Riley-style dogfooding actors are valid only for using the product.
  5. Scenario: [S] the template text is timeless. Given the template files, When they are scanned, Then no date and no personal name appears and the role is written "product owner".
- **Not in this card:** changing this repository's own board (done at re-rank 26 and in card 317); migrating existing cards.

## Context

- Filed by the facilitator on 2026-11-07 from the product owner's inbox rulings.
